reply.text:
Inbound email sync runs per message channel. Webhooks from Gmail and Microsoft now trigger a channel sync directly instead of waiting for the cron hand-off [1], and the cron path loads the channels due for sync in one query per tick [2]. Re-fetching is safe: messages that were already imported are not duplicated [3], and a missing Microsoft message is skipped rather than resetting the whole mailbox sync [4]. Dana walked through the trigger flow in #help a couple of weeks ago [5].

Dana wrote most of this code but is 78% booked this week. Marcus reviewed 12 of her sync PRs, is on your team, and has time, so I'd start with him. Want me to send him a message?
